dominant_strengths: Striking neon-green vertical light streaks deliver strong visceral hit and reinforce the brand name with literal-yet-tasteful execution
Confident type hierarchy: oversized white headline against deep black yields high contrast and clear scan path to dual CTAs
Dotted gradient frame at top edges adds craft texture without competing with the central composition
dominant_weaknesses: Headline sits low-left while hero artwork dominates right; large empty upper-left gutter weakens spatial tension and balance
CTA pair is generic pill+ghost with no Postgres/devtools specificity — reflective payoff is thin for a database product
Announcement bar, nav, and headline form three disconnected horizontal bands with no rhythmic alignment to the artwork's vertical streaks
fix_priorities: Tie headline baseline or left margin to a feature in the streak artwork to unify composition
Inject a devtools-native proof element (code snippet, latency metric, branch UI) above the fold to raise behavioral/reflective scores
Tighten vertical spacing between subline-less headline and CTAs; consider a supporting subhead to reduce abruptness
Reduce announcement-bar visual weight so the hero artwork owns the first viewport
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral leads strongly via the neon streaks, but behavioral signals (what it does) and reflective payoff (why it's different) lag behind.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a credible devtools/Postgres landing page, but leans on atmosphere over product substance to differentiate.
